lines.text: I born? Say I was born!
Many learners say: I born in a small town.
Better: I was born in a small town.
The second! She was born in May.

data.wrong: I born in a small town.
data.right: I was born in a small town.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «ولدتُ» بكلمة واحدة، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول was born: “I was born in a small town.” وليس “I born in a small town.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I born in a small town.” 😅 نقول بالعربية «ولدتُ» بكلمة واحدة، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول was born، فالجملة الصحيحة “I was born in a small town.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In Arabic we say «ولدتُ», one word, but in English we say was born: “I was born in a small town.” not “I born in a small town.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I born in a small town.” 😅 In Arabic we say «ولدتُ», one word, but in English we say was born, so the right sentence is “I was born in a small town.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
